profiles.note: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-int8-ov via OVMS 2026.3.0, --pooling LAST (mandatory: the CLS default gives 0.96 cosine between unrelated text). Qwen3-8B-int4-cw-ov (NPU channel-wise IR) via OVMS 2026.3.0 on NPU. No OpenVINO/Qwen3-7B-int4-ov on Hugging Face; 8B is the ~7B-class IR. Classification+extraction gate PASS 2026-08-06 (eval-1786013596, eval-prompts-v5, chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false): classification 28/28 schema-valid, accuracy 0.86 (≥0.80), under-called 0, missed escalations 0; extraction schema-valid 1.00, action 1.00, exact-match 0.70 (≥0.60). Latency p50/p95 7289/12893 ms. Remaining disagreements are fail-closed over-calls on repository_analysis (none→upstream_strong). Prior 1.5B: 0.71 / 2 missed; prior 8B under v3: 0.86 / 1 missed (cls-rel-2).
